run_visualize_h5_episodes: run the script to visualize keyframe images and end-effector poses from an HDF5 episode file
run_replay_trajectory_on_stretch: run the script with replay flag to replay end-effector trajectory on a Stretch robot
run_view_keyframe_images: run the script to view all keyframe images collected during a specific trial in an HDF5 file
run_plot_ee_pose_to_rviz: run the script to plot end-effector poses onto the ROS TF tree viewable in Rviz
run_introspect_h5_trial_schema: run the script to introspect and print the key schema of a trial in an HDF5 file
